text:
[RDSC.11.1] Loader errors return a status with these
`ds_err_code_t` mappings:

| Condition                                              | Code                       |
|--------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------|
| File too short to contain a `DscHeader` atom           | `DS_ERR_DSC_TRUNCATED`     |
| First atom is not a `DscHeader`, or the file is not an atom container | `DS_ERR_DSC_BAD_MAGIC` |
| `compiler_version` is outside the runtime's `<major>.<minor>.` series ([LDET.1.10]) | `DS_ERR_DSC_VERSION` |
| Atom body fails protobuf decode, whatever atom it is ([RDSC.11.4]) | `DS_ERR_DSC_DECODE` |
| Atom body decodes but violates a per-atom rule         | `DS_ERR_DSC_SEMANTIC`      |
| Atom claimed length exceeds remaining file bytes       | `DS_ERR_DSC_TRUNCATED`     |
| An atom names a schema, rule, slot or test that no atom in the bundle defines ([RDSC.8.7]); an `AlphaNode`'s schema included | `DS_ERR_DSC_DANGLING`  |
| a body declares a non-`NONE` compression codec; the runtime carries no decompressor ([RDSC.4.5.1]) | `DS_ERR_DSC_DECOMPRESS` |
| `AlphaNode`/`BetaNode`/`TerminalNode` carries `node_id` 0, or a `node_id` another of the three already holds ([RDSC.4a.3]) | `DS_ERR_RETP_INVALID` |
| `BetaNode` `left_parent_id` references form a cycle ([RDSC.4a.5]) | `DS_ERR_RETP_INVALID` |
| `AlphaNode`/`BetaNode`/`TerminalNode` node_id cross-reference not found       | `DS_ERR_RETP_INDEX_OOB`    |

An artefact with no rule network is no error ([RDSC.4a.2]).

**Framing.** A frame ([RFCS.19.1]) is malformed when its outer tag is not
`0x0A`, its inner tag is not a length-delimited field, its inner tag's field
number is in no band ([RFCS.16.3]), one of its varints runs past ten bytes, or
its `Atom` has no oneof member ([RFCS.19.3]). A loader must
refuse a malformed first frame with `DS_ERR_DSC_BAD_MAGIC`, since the bytes are
not an atom container, and a malformed later frame with `DS_ERR_DSC_DECODE`.
Where the bytes run out before a frame is complete, inside a varint or because a
declared length is longer than the bytes that remain, the code is
`DS_ERR_DSC_TRUNCATED` at any position and whatever the length; a loader that
refuses a length past its own bound before reading the body ([RFCS.19.7])
answers that code too. A body that ends early inside a complete frame fails
protobuf decode, and is `DS_ERR_DSC_DECODE` wherever its atom stands, the first
included.

**No padding is admitted.** An artefact ends at the end of its last atom. Every
byte after an atom begins a frame, so a trailing `0x00` or `0xFF` is a malformed
frame, and the loader must refuse the artefact with `DS_ERR_DSC_DECODE`. It must
not stop at such a byte and load the atoms before it: a tail that was zeroed or
erased is a truncated rule bundle ([RDSC.9.7]).
